news.title: 2 metro Atlanta officers off the force after Flock Safety audit catches misconduct
news.summary: Two members of a metro Atlanta police force are now without jobs after a recent audit of how the department uses its Flock Safety technology.

news.title: Victim was 6 when abuse began; man convicted on all 18 counts in child abuse case
news.summary: A Cherokee County jury convicted a 64-year-old man of all 18 charges he faced involving sex crimes against a child, according to the Blue Ridge Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office.

news.title: Victim of deadly Atlanta accident was 45-year-old woman, police say
